question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a orange ball, Bob has a purple ball, Claire has a green ball, Dave has a black ball, Eve has a grey ball, Fred has a gold ball, and Gertrude has a pink ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Gertrude and Claire swap balls. Then, Bob and Fred swap balls. Then, Claire and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Bob and Alice swap balls. Then, Fred and Bob swap balls. Then, Eve and Dave swap balls. Finally, Fred and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Bob has the
Options:
(A) orange ball
(B) purple ball
(C) green ball
(D) black ball
(E) grey ball
(F) gold ball
(G) pink ball
solution:
Ball colors are listed in player order: (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude).
Initial: (orange, purple, green, black, grey, gold, pink)
1. Gertrude and Claire swap: (orange, purple, pink, black, grey, gold, green)
2. Bob and Fred swap: (orange, gold, pink, black, grey, purple, green)
3. Claire and Gertrude swap: (orange, gold, green, black, grey, purple, pink)
4. Bob and Alice swap: (gold, orange, green, black, grey, purple, pink)
5. Fred and Bob swap: (gold, purple, green, black, grey, orange, pink)
6. Eve and Dave swap: (gold, purple, green, grey, black, orange, pink)
7. Fred and Claire swap: (gold, purple, orange, grey, black, green, pink)
Bob has the purple ball, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
